facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Terminocavus was discovered in the Kirtland Formation of New Mexico in 1997 and formally described in 2020.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen was discovered in the Kirtland Formation of New Mexico in 1997, and was later described and named in a 2020 study.

facts.statement: The holotype was found in grey siltstone deposits from the Campanian Hunter Wash Member of the Kirtland Formation in the San Juan Basin, New Mexico.
facts.quote: It was discovered in grey siltstone deposits from the Campanian Hunter Wash Member of the Kirtland Formation of the San Juan Basin in New Mexico.

facts.statement: The species name sealeyi honors Paul Sealey, the discoverer of the holotype specimen.
facts.quote: The specific name, sealeyi, refers to the discoverer of the holotype specimen, Paul Sealey.

facts.statement: Terminocavus lived during the late Cretaceous Period in what is now North America.
facts.quote: Terminocavus is a genus of ceratopsid dinosaur from the late Cretaceous Period of what is now North America.

facts.statement: Terminocavus sealeyi lived approximately 75 to 74.6 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the late Cretaceous in North America.
facts.quote: Terminocavus sealeyi es la única especie conocida del género Terminocavus de dinosaurio ceratópsido casmosaurino que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente de 75 a 74.6 millones de años, durante el Campaniano, en lo que hoy es Norteamérica.

facts.statement: Terminocavus had a distinctive heart-shaped upper frill with a very narrow notch, distinguishing it from its close relatives Pentaceratops and Anchiceratops.
facts.quote: It was similar in anatomy to Pentaceratops and Anchiceratops, which it was closely related to, but had a distinctive heart-shaped upper frill with very narrow notch.

facts.statement: Terminocavus is distinguished from relatives like Pentaceratops and Anchiceratops by its parietal bone, which forms a heart shape.
facts.quote: Known from limited material, Terminocavus is distinguished from close relatives such as Pentaceratops and Anchiceratops by the anatomy of its parietal (the upper portion of its frill), which forms a heart shape.

facts.statement: The parietal bars of Terminocavus are thin, extremely broad, and more plate-shaped than those of earlier relatives.
facts.quote: Terminocavus parietal bars (the top edges of the frill) are thin and extremely broad compared to earlier relatives; they are more plate-shaped than bar-shaped.

facts.statement: Terminocavus possessed six epiparietals, or small horns along the parietal, arranged symmetrically with three on each side.
facts.quote: Like most other chasmosaurs, its paired fused parietals combined bear six epiparietals (small horns along the parietal), symmetrically arranged with three on each side.

facts.statement: Terminocavus was roughly similar in adult size to Utahceratops and Pentaceratops, though its known remains are slightly smaller.
facts.quote: Terminocavus known remains are slightly smaller than those of Utahceratops and Pentaceratops, indicating it was an animal of roughly similar adult size.

facts.statement: Terminocavus is classified as a member of the ceratopsid subfamily Chasmosaurinae.
facts.quote: Terminocavus was a member of the ceratopsid subfamily Chasmosaurinae.

facts.statement: Researchers hypothesize that Terminocavus forms an anagenetic series with other chasmosaur species, representing a single population changing over time.
facts.quote: It has been hypothesized to form an anagenetic series with several other chasmosaur species.

facts.statement: The phylogenetic tree for Terminocavus is considered unstable, as removing certain taxa causes the Pentaceratops lineage to collapse into an unresolved polytomy.
facts.quote: The tree, however, is unstable; removing some taxa from the analysis caused much of the Pentaceratops-line to collapse into an unresolved polytomy.

facts.statement: The frill texture of the holotype suggests it was a young subadult, while its large size and fused epiparietals suggest it was an adult.
facts.quote: Its frill texture indicates it is a young subadult, but its large size and epiparietal fusion would indicate it represents an adult.

facts.statement: Terminocavus is distinguished from relatives like Pentaceratops and Anchiceratops by its parietal anatomy, which forms a shape similar to a heart.
facts.quote: Conocido por material limitado, Terminocavus se distingue de parientes cercanos como Pentaceratops y Anchiceratops por la anatomía de su parietal (la parte superior de su volante), que forma algo similar a un corazón.

facts.statement: The parietal bars of Terminocavus are thin and extremely wide compared to relatives, resembling plates rather than bars.
facts.quote: Las barras parietales de Terminocavus, los bordes superiores del volante, son delgadas y extremadamente anchas en comparación con los parientes anteriores; tienen más forma de placa que de barra.

facts.statement: Like most other chasmosaurines, the combined parietals of Terminocavus have six epiparietals, or small horns along the parietal, arranged symmetrically with three on each side.
facts.quote: Como la mayoría de los otros casmosaurinos, sus parietales combinados tienen seis epiparietales (pequeños cuernos a lo largo del parietal), dispuestos simétricamente con tres a cada lado.

facts.statement: The preserved right squamosal bone indicates that adults had a very large frill, similar to their relatives.
facts.quote: El escamoso derecho conservado, hueso que forma el lado derecho del volante, en sí es largo, lo que indica que los adultos tenían un volante muy grande, similar al de sus parientes.

facts.statement: Known remains of Terminocavus are slightly smaller than those of Utahceratops and Pentaceratops, indicating it was an adult animal of approximately similar size.
facts.quote: Los restos conocidos de Terminocavus son ligeramente más pequeños que los de Utahceratops y Pentaceratops, lo que indica que era un animal de tamaño adulto aproximadamente similar.

facts.statement: The holotype NMMNH P-27468, collected in 1997, consists of a parietal or fused paired parietals, other skull fragments, a partial sacrum, and vertebral fragments.
facts.quote: El holotipo NMMNH P-27468, recolectado en 1997, consiste en un parietal, o parietales emparejados fusionados, otros fragmentos de cráneo, un sacro parcial y fragmentos vertebrales.

facts.statement: The holotype was discovered in gray siltstone deposits of the Hunter Wash Member (Campanian) of the Kirtland Formation in the San Juan Basin, New Mexico.
facts.quote: Fue descubierto en depósitos de limolita gris del miembro Hunter Wash (Campaniano) de la Formación Kirtland de la Cuenca San Juan, Nuevo México.

facts.statement: Joshua Fry questioned the assignment in a master's thesis in 2015, and a phylogenetic analysis failed to group it with other Pentaceratops samples.
facts.quote: Joshua Fry cuestionó la remisión en una tesis de maestría (2015), y un análisis filogenético no logró agruparlo junto con otras muestras de Pentaceratops.

facts.statement: It was informally named as a distinct genus in 2016, and later formally named and described by Denver W. Fowler and Elizabeth A. Freedman Fowler in 2020.
facts.quote: Fue nombrado informalmente como un género distinto en 2016. Más tarde, en 2020, Denver W. Fowler y Elizabeth A. Freedman Fowler lo nombraron y describieron formalmente.

facts.statement: The generic name Terminocavus means "reaching the end of the cavity," referring to the nearly closed parietal notch before it is completely lost in more derived taxa.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico Terminocavus significa "llegar al final de la cavidad", refiriéndose a que la ensenada parietal está casi cerrada antes de perderse por completo en taxones más derivados.

facts.statement: The specific name sealeyi refers to the discoverer of the holotype specimen, Paul Sealey.
facts.quote: El nombre específico, sealeyi", se refiere al descubridor del espécimen holotipo, Paul Sealey.

facts.statement: PMU 23923 is an almost complete but very distorted skull that may belong to the species, discovered by Charles H. Sternberg in 1921 from the Kirtland Formation.
facts.quote: PMU 23923 es un cráneo casi completo, pero muy distorsionado, también puede pertenecer a la especie y proveniene de la Formación Kirtland, Charles H. Sternberg lo descubrió en 1921.

facts.statement: Terminocavus was a member of the ceratopsid subfamily Chasmosaurinae.
facts.quote: Terminocavus era un miembro de la subfamilia de ceratópsidos Chasmosaurinae.

facts.statement: Fowler and Freedman Fowler (2020) divide chasmosaurines into two lineages; a "Chasmosaurus line" leading to Kosmoceratops and a "Pentaceratops line" leading to more derived taxa, with Terminocavus belonging to the more derived line.
facts.quote: Fowler y Freedman Folwler (2020) dividen a los casmosaurinos en dos linajes; una "línea Chasmosaurus" que conduce a Kosmoceratops y una "línea Pentaceratops" que conduce a taxones más derivados. Terminocavus pertenece al más derivado.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis found Terminocavus to be relatively derived, more basal than Anchiceratops but more derived than Navajoceratops.
facts.quote: El análisis filogenético encontró que era relativamente derivado, más basal que Anchiceratops pero más derivado que Navajocertops.

facts.statement: It was proposed that Terminocavus is part of a long anagenetic lineage of chasmosaurines.
facts.quote: Se propuso que Terminocavus es parte de un largo linaje anagenético de casmosaurinos.

facts.statement: Terminocavus lived during the Campanian stage, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The age of the specimen is undetermined; its frill texture suggests a young subadult, but its large size and epiparietal fusion indicate it represents an adult.
facts.quote: La edad del espécimen no está determinada; su textura de volantes indica que es un subadulto joven, pero su gran tamaño y fusión epiparietal indicarían que representa a un adulto.

facts.statement: The phylogenetic tree is unstable; removing some taxa caused much of the Pentaceratops line to collapse into an unresolved polytomy.
facts.quote: El árbol, sin embargo, es inestable; la eliminación de algunos taxones del análisis provocó que gran parte de la línea de Pentaceratops colapsara en una politomía no resuelta.

facts.statement: It was observed that this could negatively impact the results of the analysis.
facts.quote: Se observó que esto podría estar impactando negativamente los resultados.
